flows.name: Comments pipeline
flows.desc: retired — the comment layer + SPA that served it are both retired; no implementation and no served door remain (engine/src/index.js carries zero comments routes)

flows.name: Onboarding
flows.desc: a person with Claude and the org's MCP URL + a key is working in the org — no SDLC, no machine seat

steps.does: add the org's MCP URL + key to Claude

flows.name: Dev agent
flows.desc: builds the change, proves it, opens it for review — and leaves it clean

steps.does: assigned to a machine — never claimed
build in an isolated worktree
self-test → gate → PR
pre-land staleness check — the base hasn't moved underneath this PR
land

flows.name: Live agent
flows.desc: comments become a plan, the plan becomes a PR, you watch it cook

steps.does: pin comments anywhere → queue them
cook the plan — visualised, Agent plan #N
comment on the plan, then confirm
run the plan — live AOI, chip, checkpoints
PR raised → land

flows.name: PR agent
flows.desc: raised PRs get a reviewed verdict before the human lands

steps.does: review → verdict comment
land

flows.name: Per-push cycle
flows.desc: retired — every push became a prioritised re-verify direction for the local QA pipeline, which is gone

steps.does: code-inspect — signals only, never code bodies
atlas + recipe + briefing refresh
worklist written — the QA door

flows.name: QA agent
flows.desc: the shipped app proven screen by screen, findings filed with Agent R

steps.does: drive · assert · discover on the booted device or browser
findings filed with the org's Agent R over MCP, evidence attached

flows.name: Vision agent
flows.desc: every screen compared with the design, misses named exactly and filed with Agent R

steps.does: resolve the layered rubric — platform conventions + tenant brand
grade screens — exact token, expected vs observed

flows.name: Plan agent
flows.desc: plans are visualised artifacts inside the build loop — not a separate agent

head.title: The rich canvas on Map is the HIGHLIGHT and the HOOK - it is the surface sharingu is shown by
ONE standard filing schema, set by sharingu and changed only when sharingu updates — no per-org extension. The generalisation test is the gate on any field entering it
Anyone publishes freely - publishing is an OFFER, not an imposition; equipping is the other member's choice
NO INPUTS on the framework app - agents file everything; a person's entire input surface is CHOOSING among filed options
Broadcast is its own tab: publish a skill, agent or workflow; any user equips it; updates push to holders
Fix boot.sql's people.role comment — 'leader' is a real live role and the schema's documentation is stale
A goal node carries an accountable owner and a due-by/window
RE-RULED: EIGHT tabs - Home, Build, GTM, Goals, Decisions, Map, Broadcast, Control
ONE versioning spine across every filed object - architecture, canvas, wireframes, rulings, filings, goals, schema, the door contract, broadcast items, presets and manifests
transmission_refs is the fan-out — a contribution can touch anything on the canvas, goals or GTM planes, and touching it updates the UI
Drop loops entirely — its pointer was dropped, its tools are cut, and only filings matter
A leader must be able to FILE and be MEASURED — the dimension gets fields, submit kinds and a proof rule like the other five; what the unit of contribution is remains the owner's to name
Goal movement TRACED BACK to the person's decisions - the filing moved the goal, the filing flowed from your ruling, you get the credit
Fold the outreach ledger into the goal-node screen — no standalone outreach screen
Equipping is per WORKSPACE - the workspace holds it, everyone working there gets it
Fix both — the no-pack denial highlights the wrong tab, and a comment claims a leader landing that was never built
RE-RULED: Map is SEVEN planes - Architecture, System, Data, API and webhooks, MCP and skills, Flows, Dependencies
A campaign is BOTH — its own filing and a goal-tree node
sharingu Brand Guidelines v2 is THE design law for every sharingu surface, superseding all three token docs
people is authored — the FIRST member of an org is automatically its admin, and admin is transferable to another member
A leader's unit of contribution is a DECISION — submitKinds decision/ruling, fields touches + why, proof: the decision recorded with what it unblocked
ONE KEY for every purpose — admin provisions the person and hands the key over manually; the user can rotate it later. The invite-code flow goes away
Fold it into the people list itself - manage access where the person is, no separate surface
THE BOARD MUST BE PRISTINE FIRST - and pristine is COMPUTED, never felt: seven conditions the board already measures, checked by tools/pristine.mjs, which refuses
Home carries what the project IS, its aim, who is here, the leaderboard, what needs you, and ask-anything
Workspaces stay ONE column in ONE database — but every read goes through one helper that requires a workspace, and a check proves no raw query escapes it
Capture REAL screens — a CDP walk per console route, a PNG per screen, referenced from screens[].states[].shot as saruspay does

A FILING IS WHAT MOVES THE BRAIN — one standard schema, multi-dimensional, updating progress, goals and the contribution trail across every page; and EVERY filing carries a goal, either an existing one or a new one it creates
The real screens, empty, each with a clear empty status - no guided first run, no seeding
No-inputs removes the KEYBOARD, not the TRIGGER - twelve verbs, twelve buttons, zero text fields
login_attempts stays, made as standard and as cheap as possible for free-tier Cloudflare
Counter-file is a control that rides on any filing, everywhere it is shown - built once, reused

R owns the FILING rules and the eval set, and nothing about how work gets done — every process rule (a PR's shape, a design's wireframe/layout/standards) is owned and defined BY the dev and design agents themselves

PROOF is ruled from the doctrine already written — a filing's proof must satisfy its own lane's proof rule, and the schema REFUSES one that does not; `kind` is raised per lane because it needs the generalisation test
Give /profile a real lane — R is the product now, so its nav must tell the truth
Every plane must be 1:1 and correct — a wrong wireframe is a defect, and screens, flows, data model, database, MCP and architecture must all agree
Drop the claims metric together with the loops table - do not rebuild it on transmission_refs
Cut the MCP door to NINE plain verbs — whoami, list, get, find, file, attach, mine, decide, grade — with decide and grade given a read twin
Anyone may file, at any time — but every filing carries who it is attributed to
R publishes the eval set through its own door, and an agent pulls it ONCE into local state — after that only UPDATES come down, so the common grader costs almost no cloud read or write
Declare a REAL objective tree for sharingu itself and file against it

ONE ORG WORKER: only ryuklabs-agent-r stays. The siru, saruspay (sarus), bunny and ryuklabs projects move INTO the ryuklabs org, with their people (seats) and records carried into its database, and each old database is backed up to its own project's folder first. Only then are siru-agent-r, veil-agent-r and bunny-agent-r (worker, D1, KV, R2) and the launcher agent-r-frame deleted. The git brain repos are kept for later updates.
A COUNTER IS A FILING. The session already doing the work produces it, carrying its reasoning, conformed to the standards and rules, fanned out like any other filing

RE-RULED: the org carries ONE monotonic state version, bumped in the same transaction as any fan-out write and returned on every response. Everyone knows the org's sync state at any moment; a screen that is behind SAYS SO rather than looking current
tokens stays — one key per person, issued and rotatable here, and it is where ADMIN defines which workspaces that person can reach
artifacts is authored WITH A STRONGER RULE than drafted — a filing must carry extracted meaning and its relation to the product, never a raw dump
Equipped items are pinned to the version equipped; an update notice appears and the holder chooses
Leaderboard ranks by goal movement, broken out per area, and lives on Home
The todo list is DERIVED from the goal tree — a person's outstanding work is the nodes in their lane with no filing against them — PLUS ad-hoc items that can be promoted into the tree
A filing FANS OUT - every surface it touches updates together: its list, the goal it moves, the leaderboard, the canvas node, the dependency chain, the counts on Home
Link workspaces from the org switcher; leave l-health direct-link-only
transmission is the core ledger — and a filing lands against one of THREE planes: canvas, goals or GTM
Drop events.session_id with the sessions table

The Telegram bot is PER-ORG CONFIG: the org's admin sets it when the bot joins the team's group, it's stored in the org's worker, and it drives that org's alerts and broadcast. It is never in sharingu's env.
